# It's FOSS

> It's FOSS is a comprehensive Linux and open source news platform providing breaking coverage, in-depth guides, and community resources for developers and enthusiasts.

It's FOSS delivers daily Linux news, distribution reviews, and open source software coverage alongside curated learning resources and membership benefits. The site serves as a central hub for the Linux community with original reporting on major releases, security initiatives, and industry developments.

## Key Topics

- Linux
- GNOME
- Fedora
- Open Source
- Desktop Environment
- Linux News
- FOSS Community
- Distro Releases
- Security
- Wayland
- X11
- Linux Tools
- Backup Tools
- Apple Silicon
- Community

## News & Updates

- [Latest Linux and Open Source News](https://itsfoss.com/news): Archive of latest Linux and open source news articles
- [GNOME 50 is Here, and X11 is Finally Gone](https://itsfoss.com/news/gnome-50-release): Release news for GNOME 50 with X11 removal and Wayland
- [Fedora Asahi Remix 43 Arrives with Mac Pro Support](https://itsfoss.com/news/fedora-asahi-remix-43-release): Release news for Fedora Asahi Remix 43 with Apple Silicon
- [Systemd's New Feature Brings Age Verification Option to Linux](https://itsfoss.com/news/systemd-age-verification): News article on systemd age verification compliance feature
- [Ageless Linux Emerges to Protest OS-Level Age Verification Laws](https://itsfoss.com/news/ageless-linux): News on Ageless Linux distro protesting age verification laws
- [Manjaro Linux Team Goes on Strike](https://itsfoss.com/news/manjaro-team-strike): News on Manjaro team strike and governance restructuring
- [AI Companies Put $12.5M Into Open Source Security](https://itsfoss.com/news/ai-companies-fund-open-source-security): News on AI companies funding open source security initiatives
- [FOSS Weekly #26.12: GNOME 50 Release, Fedora for Apple](https://itsfoss.com/newsletter/foss-weekly-26-12): FOSS Weekly newsletter covering Linux news and updates
